ring.description: AT URI of the blog.rebase.webring.ring record being joined

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the publication owner accepted

publication.description: AT URI of the site.standard.publication record joining the ring. Must match an entry in the ring's members array for the membership to count.

schema.description: A publication owner's acceptance of a place in a webring. Written to the repo of the account that owns the publication; deleting it leaves the ring.
